overview.headline: A Landmark Collection of Waterfront Residences in Brickell
overview.description: The St. Regis Residences Miami introduces a collection of ultra-luxury waterfront homes designed to deliver the legendary St. Regis lifestyle with expansive floorplans, private elevator entry, panoramic Biscayne Bay views, and world-class hospitality services.
